blocks.text: The user reported on Quest 0.2.7 that Shop had no highlight and could not be clicked after extinguishing fires. This is a specific negative interaction observation, not acceptance of the rest of the game.

Quest 0.2.7 / code 10 was installed and its running process observed; see Logs/EmberdeepQuest027Install/Install.json. The later user report specifically identifies a failed Shop interaction. Do not reuse the prior installation or 167/87 Editor results as acceptance of this revision.

Two input gates cause the obstruction: proximity of a held tool to supply blocks both hands, and an existing dock lock rejects Gear shop even in a tradable phase. Correct per-hand eligibility and permit the valid Shop transition through existing cleanup.

Remove the global held-tool NearStation gate that blocks both hands. Evaluate each hand independently: keep its own nearStation/nearLever exclusions and operating-hand priority. An eligible free hand away from those reserved controls may highlight and activate visible UI with its own fresh pinch.

When Run.InSupply allows trading, a docked tool must not hide or block the Gear shop entry from the eligible free hand. OpenShop returns the tool and disconnects supply through existing cleanup, cancels unfinished strokes/charge and enters the shop without granting water.

Retain Run.InSupply as the purchase gate. The fix does not enable shopping during Fighting, change item prices, grant water, or settle unearned rewards. Closing the shop and re-equipping require normal input rearming.
